pitch: Each master played 1.55 times higher and 1.15 times faster with ffmpeg (record.py), before the textures.
excluded: API keys, execution logs, decoded intermediates and the MP3 masters, which stay outside the repo.
review: All takes unreviewed by ear. Intended delivery labels are not listening guarantees.

textures.original: Decoded to 16-bit mono 11.025 kHz with macOS afconvert, then 8-bit.
textures.robot-soft: 150 Hz high-pass; 8% mild saturation; 8% 12-bit/sample-hold texture; 12% 92 Hz ring modulation; 4.2 kHz low-pass.

compression.masters: Local archive; not distributed. Their hashes are in the manifest.
